_about: Partners whose stores are NOT Shopify (Tiffany Nov 11 3:04pm: "that doesn't mean their store isn't watched... you have to watch it differently"). We promise every partner their whole inventory is in the app, Shopify or not. scripts/watch/nonshopify_watch.py reads each store by its own method and writes into config/partner-products-snapshot.json, so partner_coverage and the partner watch treat them like everyone else. If a method fails (rate limit, page change), the run must fall back to Chrome (open the shop page, list every product) the same day, plus the brand's Instagram and newsletter. Add a brand here the moment we learn its store isn't Shopify.
